name: Ichidou Haruno
source:
The aunt of the main character. She is married and is the owner and manager of the apartment building.

She has a generous and gentle personality, but she sometimes shows her strict side to the main character because she wants him to pass the entrance exam this year.

Recently, she gave birth to a baby.

She is not fond of cockroaches.

[From [url=http://plum.sakura.ne.jp/~tabito/g_hp2/game2.html]official site[/url]]
